question: Provide a detailed web sales report for each region, including the number of orders, total sales amount, and the name and sales amount of all sales representatives who achieved the highest total sales amount in that region (include all representatives in case of a tie).
sql:
-- Final query: region summary + top sales rep(s) per region
WITH region_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        wr.name AS region_name,
        COUNT(wo.id) AS num_orders,
        SUM(wo.total_amt_usd) AS total_sales
    FROM web_orders wo
    JOIN web_accounts wa ON wo.account_id = wa.id
    JOIN web_sales_reps wsr ON wa.sales_rep_id = wsr.id
    JOIN web_region wr ON wsr.region_id = wr.id
    GROUP BY wr.name
),
region_rep_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        wr.name AS region_name,
        wsr.name AS rep_name,
        SUM(wo.total_amt_usd) AS rep_total_sales
    FROM web_orders wo
    JOIN web_accounts wa ON wo.account_id = wa.id
    JOIN web_sales_reps wsr ON wa.sales_rep_id = wsr.id
    JOIN web_region wr ON wsr.region_id = wr.id
    GROUP BY wr.name, wsr.name
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        region_name,
        rep_name,
        rep_total_sales,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY region_name ORDER BY rep_total_sales DESC) AS rnk
    FROM region_rep_sales
)
SELECT 
    rt.region_name,
    rt.num_orders,
    ROUND(rt.total_sales, 2) AS total_sales,
    rn.rep_name AS top_rep_name,
    ROUND(rn.rep_total_sales, 2) AS top_rep_sales
FROM region_totals rt
JOIN ranked rn ON rt.region_name = rn.region_name AND rn.rnk = 1
ORDER BY rt.region_name
